name: meteor-module-federation
description: Module Federation with Meteor 3.6 (Rspack): a Meteor host loading a Meteor remote and an Rsbuild remote

scripts.prod:remote: npm --prefix apps/remote-widgets run build && npm --prefix apps/remote-widgets run preview
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/meteor-remote run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/meteor-host run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/remote-widgets run typecheck
